"''Thanks, Toht.|Toht, greeting Qi'ra on [[Savareen]]|}} '''Toht Ra''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Hylobon]] who served as member of [[Dryden Vos]]' [[Hylobon Enforcers|security forces]], working as an attendant aboard the ''[[First Light]]''. Ra confiscated all weapons brought aboard the [[yacht]] by guests. He carried a [[percussive cannon]] and [[vibrocutlass]] in case of trouble. [[Qi'ra]], Vos' [[Lieutenant (criminal)|lieutenant]] later used Ra's weapon when she [[Showdown on Savareen|fought]] Vos.{{EncyclopediaCite|Melee and Ranged Weapons}} {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== In answering a fan question about whether or not Toht Ra's name derives from the ''[[Indiana Jones]]'' franchise, [[Phil Szostak]] noted that the character was named after [[W:c:indianajones:Arnold Ernst Toht|Arnold Ernst Toht]], the [[Wikipedia:Gestapo|Gestapo]] agent from the [[1981]] film [[W:c:indianajones:Raiders of the Lost Ark|''Raiders of the Lost Ark'']] (written by [[Lawrence Kasdan]]) who burns his hand on the [[W:c:indianajones:Headpiece to the Staff of Ra|headpiece to the Staff of Ra]], though he suspects that [[Lucasfilm Story Group]]'s [[Pablo Hidalgo]] was most likely the one who came up with the name.{{Twitter|PhilSzostak|status/1000414857814933504|[[Phil Szostak]]|quote=Undoubtedly, Raiders was the source of those names. But I don't believe he was named by the Solo creature team that I interviewed. Very likely, Pablo Hidalgo came up with that one.|archivedate=20200814154338}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Toht Ra}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 6|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 6]] ==Sources== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|Toht Ra}} *{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Solo: A Star Wars Story|cardname=Dryden's Enforcer Guard}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Melee and Ranged Weapons}} *{{Databank|toht-ra|Toht Ra}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Toht Ra |ja=トート・ラ |ka=ტოტ რა |pl=Toht Ra |uk=Тот Ра }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ra, Toht}} [[Category:Guards]] [[Category:Hylobon Enforcers]] [[Category:Hylobons]] [[Category:Males]]
